text_en: On that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; he sets up victory like walls and bulwarks.
text_cn: 那一天，犹大地要咏唱这首歌曲：“我们有座坚城，以救援作城墙与外郭。

text_en: Open the gates, so that the righteous nation that keeps faith may enter in.
text_cn: 你们打开城门，好让遵守信实的正义民族进去。

text_en: Those of steadfast mind you keep in peace— in peace because they trust in you.
text_cn: 你的意志坚定，因而你保全了永久的和平，故此人对你有信赖。

text_en: Trust in the Lord forever, for in the Lord God you have an everlasting rock.
text_cn: 你们应永远信赖上主，因为上主是永固的磐石。

text_en: For he has brought low the inhabitants of the height; the lofty city he lays low. He lays it low to the ground, casts it to the dust.
text_cn: 他曾屈服了居高位的人，推翻了高耸的城市， 将她推翻在地，使她粉碎，化为尘埃。

text_en: The foot tramples it, the feet of the poor, the steps of the needy.
text_cn: 践踏她的，却是困苦人的脚，是贫穷人的脚。”

text_en: The way of the righteous is level; O Just One, you make smooth the path of the righteous.
text_cn: 义人的道路是正直的，你上主啊，削平了正直人的途径。

text_en: In the path of your judgments, O Lord , we wait for you; your name and your renown are the soul’s desire.
text_cn: 的确，上主！我们在你正义的路上期待你！你的名号，你的记念，是我们心灵的欲望。

text_en: My soul yearns for you in the night, my spirit within me earnestly seeks you. For when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
text_cn: 我们的心灵在夜间渴望你，我们的心神在清晨寻觅你，因为当你的决断显于大地时，世上的居民都要学习正义。

text_en: If favor is shown to the wicked, they do not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness they deal perversely and do not see the majesty of the Lord .
text_cn: 恶人虽然蒙受了怜悯，仍然不学习正义，在世上依然颠倒是非，毫不顾及上主的威严。

text_en: O Lord , your hand is lifted up, but they do not see it. Let them see your zeal for your people, and be ashamed. Let the fire for your adversaries consume them.
text_cn: 上主！你的手虽已高举，但他们仍看不见；愿他们见到你对百姓的热忱而感到惭愧；并愿你为你仇敌所保留的烈火吞灭他们！

text_en: O Lord , you will ordain peace for us, for indeed, all that we have done, you have done for us.
text_cn: 上主！是你赐与了我们和平，因为凡我们所做的，都是你为我们成就的！

text_en: O Lord our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us, but we acknowledge your name alone.
text_cn: 上主，我们的天主！除你以外，还有别的主宰治理过我们；然而我们所称扬的，只有你，你的名号。

text_en: The dead do not live; shades do not rise— because you have punished and destroyed them, and wiped out all memory of them.
text_cn: 死去的人不会再活，幽魂也不会复生，因为你如此惩罚了，并消灭了他们，使他们所有的记念尽被遗忘。

text_en: But you have increased the nation, O Lord , you have increased the nation; you are glorified; you have enlarged all the borders of the land.
text_cn: 你增加了本国的人民，上主，你增加了本国的人民，你得了光荣，你拓展了国家所有的边界。

text_en: O Lord , in distress they sought you, they poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
text_cn: 上主！我们在困难之中寻求了你，我们在压迫之中呼求了你，因为那是你对我们的惩罚。

text_en: Like a woman with child, who writhes and cries out in her pangs when she is near her time, so were we because of you, O Lord ;
text_cn: 有如怀妊临产的妇女，在苦痛中痉挛呻吟；同样，上主！我们在你面前也是如此：

text_en: we were with child, we writhed, but we gave birth only to wind. We have won no victories on earth, and no one is born to inhabit the world.
text_cn: 我们也像怀妊痉挛；然而所产的竟是风， 没有给大地带来救恩，世界的居民也未因此而得生。

text_en: Your dead shall live, their corpses shall rise. O dwellers in the dust, awake and sing for joy! For your dew is a radiant dew, and the earth will give birth to those long dead.
text_cn: 你的亡者将再生，他们的尸体将要起立；睡在尘埃中的人们都要苏醒歌咏，因为你的朝露是晶莹的朝露，大地将抛出幽灵。

text_en: Come, my people, enter your chambers, and shut your doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until the wrath is past.
text_cn: 我的百姓！去，进入你的内室，关上门，隐藏片刻，等待盛怒过去。

text_en: For the Lord comes out from his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; the earth will disclose the blood shed on it, and will no longer cover its slain.
text_cn: 因为，看哪！上主已由自己的地方出来惩罚大地居民的罪恶，大地要暴露自己吞下的鲜血，不再遮掩被杀的人。
